Agendas, Minutes & Video

Public Participation

City Council, commission, and committee meetings are open to the public. The public can view the City Council and Planning Commission meetings online and in person, and all other commission and committee meetings are open to the public to attend in person. In addition to attending meetings, the public can provide public comment on the items on the agenda, and on items not on the agenda under that body’s jurisdiction.

City Council Meetings

The City Council generally meets on the first and third Tuesday of the month at 7:00 p.m. in the Peter W. Snyder Council Chamber, 100 Civic Plaza. In addition to participating in person, the public can view meetings live on Comcast T.V. channel 28, at tv28live.org, and on the City’s website at WATCH MEETINGS. Meeting agendas are available below in advance of each meeting.

Click the 'Subscribe' image to the left to sign-up to receive City Council agendas via email.

To learn how to participate in public meetings in-person and remotely, and how to request assistance, visit this page about How to Participate in a City Council Meeting.

View the 2026 City Council Meeting Schedule

City Commissions and Committees

Meeting schedules and locations are posted online on the meeting body's informational webpage.

Planning Commission meetings can be viewed on the City’s website at WATCH MEETINGS.

Meeting Agendas

Meetings are arranged by date, with the most recent at the top of the list. For City Council meetings prior to November 2025, click "video" to watch the meeting and view agenda documents, or Agenda or Minutes to see just the documents. For meetings prior to 2021, the packet can be found by clicking Agenda. You can also search the archives by typing keywords into the "Search" box. *Email Updates are currently for City Council meetings only*

Planning Commission and City Council meetings after November 2025 can be viewed on the City’s website at WATCH MEETINGS.

Archived meeting Agendas and Minutes prior to 2020 can be found here. City Council Videos prior to 2020 can be requested here.
